'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****[[Ukrainian occupation of Kursk Oblast]]
*****[[Ukraine]] establishes a [[military administration]] in [[Sudzha]] with major general [[Eduard Moskalyov]] appointed as its senior commander. General [[Oleksandr Syrskyi]] says that the administration will "maintain law and order" in the region. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9qgwvjj9d1o.amp (BBC News)]
****[[Russia]] announces the mandatory evacuation of all [[civilian]]s from [[Glushkovsky District]] in [[Kursk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-evacuate-thousands-more-kursk-region-attacked-by-ukraine-2024-08-15/ (Reuters)]
****The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] claims that Russian forces have retaken the settlement of Krupets. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russian-forces-drive-ukrainian-troops-out-of-krupets-settlement-in-kursk-region/3304830 (Anadolu Agency)]
****The [[Security Service of Ukraine]] captures 102 Russian servicemen as [[Prisoner of war|prisoners of war]], marking the largest single group of Russian soldiers to surrender during [[Russo-Ukrainian War|the conflict]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-08-15/ukraine-reports-largest-surrender-by-russian-troops-of-the-war (Bloomberg)]
***[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] and military vehicles enter Russia's [[Belgorod Oblast]] with the region declaring a [[state of emergency]]. Heavy fighting is reportedly underway. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/15/russia-ukraine-kursk-captured-soldiers/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Pokrovsk offensive]]
****[[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]]'s military administration issues immediate evacuation orders for its citizens due to shelling from [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]] about 10 km away from the city in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://unn.ua/en/news/occupants-approach-pokrovsk-authorities-ask-residents-to-evacuate (UNN)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] says that Ukraine can use British weaponry, including [[Challenger 2]] tanks, for its military operations inside Russia. [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-russia-war-latest-moscow-concerned-about-rapid-ukrainian-advances-as-satellite-image-reveals-russian-fortifications-in-invaded-region-12541713 (Sky News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Evacuations during the Gaza war]]
***[[Peter Dutton]], the leader of [[Australia]]’s [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal Party]], calls on the [[Australian government]] to ban the entry of [[Palestinian refugees]] fleeing from conflict in the [[Gaza Strip]], which is met with significant condemnation from several politicians and organizations as promoting [[racial stereotype]]s. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-08-14/dutton-says-people-fleeing-gaza-should-not-a-granted-a-visa/104222320 (ABC Australia)] [https://aje.io/nuquob?update=3119406 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[SBS World News]] reports that the Australian government has rejected a majority of [[Palestinian]] [[Visa policy of Australia|visa applications]], accepting 2,922 applications and rejecting 7,111 applications while granting 8,746 visas to [[Israelis|Israeli citizens]] and rejecting only 235 applications. [https://aje.io/nuquob?update=3119441 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Casualties of the Gaza war]]
***The [[Gaza Health Ministry]] reports that more than 40,000 [[Palestinians]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], including more than 16,000 children, have been killed due to the ongoing [[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|Israeli invasion]] and [[Blockade of the Gaza Strip|blockade]], and that more than 10,000 Palestinians are still missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/15/israel-war-on-gaza-live-no-respite-from-attacks-as-truce-talks-scheduled (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] launches four rockets at [[IDF]] targets in [[Shamir, Israel|Shamir]] and [[Malkia]] in [[Upper Galilee]] which were intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]] causing a fire in Shamir and [[Kfarchouba|Ruwaysat al-Alam of Kfarchouba]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/15/israel-war-on-gaza-live-no-respite-from-attacks-as-truce-talks-scheduled (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*American [[Video game journalism|video game magazine]] ''[[Game Informer]]'' discontinues publication after 33 years. The magazine's website is also shut down. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce9z8k8g0g9o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[Russian Air Force]] [[Tupolev Tu-22M]] crashes due to a "technical malfunction" in [[Irkutsk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. The pilots safely ejected, according to Russian media. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-siberia-bomber-jet-crash/33080286.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Sweden]] reports the first case of the new [[mpox]] variant outside [[Africa]] in a patient in [[Stockholm]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2567549/world (Arab News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/who-confirms-first-case-new-mpox-strain-outside-africa-outbreak-spreads-2024-08-15/ (Reuters)]
**[[Pakistan]] reports its first case of [[mpox]] this year. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/pakistan-confirms-first-mpox-case-of-2024-infected-person-came-from-saudi-arabia-13805046.html/amp (First Post)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–United States relations]], [[Foreign relations of NATO]]
**The [[United States]] approves the sale of 600 [[MIM-104 Patriot]] [[surface-to-air missile|air defense missiles]] to [[Germany]] worth US$5 billion ([[Euro|€]]4.6 billion) to improve German national defense and the overall security of [[NATO]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-approves-5-billion-patriot-missile-sale-to-germany/a-69956458 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage]]
**[[Ukraine]] denies its involvement in explosions that damaged the [[Nord Stream|Nord Stream 2 pipeline]] in 2022 and accuses [[Russia]] of causing the explosions, following [[Germany]] issuing its first [[Arrest warrant|arrest warrant]] on the case towards a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] man. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-presidential-adviser-denies-ukraines-involvement-nord-stream-explosions-2024-08-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[New Zealand]] extradites German hacker and [[Megaupload]] founder [[Kim Dotcom]] to the United States to face charges for [[computer fraud]], [[cyber espionage]], and [[embezzlement]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/megauploads-kim-dotcom-to-be-extradited-to-united-states/a-69951276 (DW)]
*[[Croatia]]n Defence Minister [[Ivan Anušić]] announces that the country will reintroduce a compulsory 2-month [[conscription|military service]] starting from January 1, 2025, as part of it's reform of the [[Armed Forces of Croatia]]. Conscription was previously scrapped in 2008 when Croatia shifted to a volunteer-based system. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/croatia-military-draft-russia-conscription-b2598298.html (''The Independent'')]
